analytics.name: Analytic 1770
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Web Service by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App stages or caches content retrieved from web-service platform locally before initiating secondary network connection]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Per-platform approved apps for each web service (e.g., GitHub: com.github.android; Dropbox: com.dropbox.android). Derive from MDM catalog. Apps accessing web service platforms outside their declared function are anomalous.
Per-app declared network destinations from Info.plist or AndroidManifest network config. Legitimate web-service access should be declared.
Default 120s between web-service platform session and novel C2 connection. Tightening: 30s — synchronous resolve-then-connect. Loosening: 300s — catches deferred pivot.
